title: Stasis Soldier
description: A soldier in full camouflage uniform and cap stands bent over on a cracked desert highway that stretches into distant mountains. The surreal scene includes a large red sun in a green sky, the word STASIS dripping in black paint above, and a glossy red Christmas ornament with holly leaves on the right side.
prompt: Surreal painting of a soldier in camouflage uniform and cap bent over standing on a cracked desert road leading toward distant mountains under a green sky with a large red sun. The word STASIS appears in large dripping black letters above him. To the right is a large shiny red Christmas bauble with green holly leaves and red berries. Cracked texture, dystopian atmosphere, detailed rendering.
